Q: IntelliJ Test Code Coverage not displayed in code A:

I'm using IntelliJ 2023.2.5 (Community Edition) MAC JDK11 (temurin). To get the code coverage to show for test classes (Cucumber Stepdef stuff) using JUnit I had to do: Run->Edit Configuration->Modify options (top right)-> Collect coverage in test folders. Then the coverage showed up:

Q: gRPC connection: use keepAlive or idleTimeout? A:

I think keepAlive will be suitable .
